verdict.rationale: Marketing chat copy mentions mapping existing deal data and providing a migration checklist during onboarding, and the platform's flexible object/list model plus enrichment/sync features suggest a workspace could be set up quickly, but there is no concrete documentation of a self-serve import wizard, CSV/spreadsheet import flow, or any time-to-value evidence supporting a sub-hour, partner-free setup. Missing for 10: a documented self-serve data import/migration tool, a quick-start guide with concrete steps/time estimates, and independent evidence (case study, review) confirming fast unaided onboarding.
